title: Engaging Customers with AI in Online Chats: Evidence from a Randomized Field Experiment
eligible_reason: Design qualifies formally (binary AI_enabled switches on at agent-specific days: 117 treated agents across 46 distinct first-adoption days, 18 never-treated agents; agent FE + day FE; clustered by agent), but every main-text regression includes the time-varying control logagent_tenure (log days since the agent joined, varies within agent over time), and sentiment regressions also control for start_sentiment. Per PROTOCOL 5b a time-varying control in every reported column is NOT eligible; recorded as a near-miss.
design_notes: Conversation-level data (228,558 conversations, 80% random sample), xtset agent_id; xtreg y AI_enabled logagent_tenure i.daily, fe r (agent FE, day FE, vce robust = clustered by agent in xtreg fe). Table 2: logresponse_time (line 19). Table 3: logNmsg_agent, logNmsg_customer, logconversation_duration (lines 24-26). Table 5: end_sentiment with start_sentiment control (line 36). Tables 4, 6, 8, 9: AI_enabled interacted with tenure, start sentiment, intent category, chatbot issues. Table 7: adds mediators. Web Appendix: randomization checks (adoption_day on pre-period agent characteristics), SUTVA test with NumTreated interaction, first-week spillover test, logit for intent assignment, fect (IFE counterfactual estimator) on agent-day aggregates with cov(logagent_tenure). AI_enabled is absorbing at the agent-day level (no switch-off; 43 agent-days mixed = adoption day). Adoption days range 47-276 of 362, with two main waves (days 47-53 and 147-152).
estimators_reported: TWFE static (xtreg fe with agent FE and day FE, time-varying tenure control, robust/cluster-agent SE)
fect interactive-fixed-effects counterfactual estimator (Web Appendix B)
modern_estimators_named: fect (Liu-Wang-Xu IFE counterfactual; appendix only, not in protocol list)

near_miss_specs.reason: would be eligible if logagent_tenure were dropped

ineligible_specs.reason: time-varying control logagent_tenure in every column (Table 5/7 also start_sentiment and mediators)
treatment interacted with tenure, start sentiment, intent category, chatbot issues, NumTreated, first-week indicator (subgroup/continuous interactions) plus time-varying controls

ineligible_specs.location: Web Appendix Table S2 Panel B

ineligible_specs.reason: interactive fixed effects counterfactual estimator with covariates; appendix

data_files: replication pacakge/AI_in_Online_Chats_Data.dta (228,558 conversations; 34 variables; random 80% sample of the original data; agent_id disguised but consistent; 135 agents; 362 days Dec 2020-Nov 2021)
replication_feasible_note: Data and code present and simple; a TWFE without logagent_tenure can be run immediately, but it would not be a reported specification. Published estimates themselves reproducible only approximately (80% sample).
screener_notes: Screened from package only. RCT with staggered rollout of AI assistance to agents; authors treat it as a staggered DiD with agent and day FE. Near-miss under the time-varying-control rule (same call as mnsc.2021.01010). If the lead decides to relax the rule for a single deterministic tenure control, Table 2 col 1 and Table 3 cols 1-3 would be eligible static specs with 46 cohorts and 18 never-treated agents, clustered by agent (135 clusters).
